name: Ghana
dated: VAT Act 2013 (Act 870) and Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) as enacted (later amendments not consolidated in the local copies): grade B
sources: Sources: VAT Act 2013 (Act 870) (registry fetch `global/registry/afm_data/fetch/GH/gh_vat870.pdf.txt`); Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) OCR (`world/B10-anglophone-africa/gh/law/act896_ocr.txt`).

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: VAT Act 2013 (Act 870) s. 3 (15 %) [text version: Act 870 (2013) and Act 896 (2015) as enacted (gazetted copies), Act 896 para 3 (1) as restated by Act 1094 (2023); later amending Acts not consolidated (flag)]
vat.doc: s. 3: "Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the rate of the tax is fifteen percent and is calculated on the value of the taxable supply". The NHIL, GETFund levy and COVID-19 levy charged with VAT (separate acts), the flat-rate scheme and the exempt schedule were not read; the 2025 VAT reform (Act 1151, 2025) not checked.
notes: Ghana: NHIL, GETFund and COVID-19 levies (separate acts) and the VAT exempt schedule not modelled; every line at 15 %

excise.name: Excise duty (Act 878)
excise.why: only an abridged guide of Act 878 is held (a secondary text) and the 2023-2025 amendments are not

cit.name: Income tax (companies)
cit.statute: Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) First Schedule para 3 (1) (25 %) [text version: Act 870 (2013) and Act 896 (2015) as enacted (gazetted copies), Act 896 para 3 (1) as restated by Act 1094 (2023); later amending Acts not consolidated (flag)]
cit.doc: First Schedule para 3 (1): "The chargeable income of a company other than a company principally engaged in the hotel industry … is taxed at the rate of twenty-five percent"; (2) hotels 22 %; (3) non-traditional exports 8 %.
notes: Act 896 with Act 1094 (2023), which restates para 3 (1) at 25 % (OCR of the gazette copy); other later rate changes not checked
the Growth and Sustainability Levy (Act 1095, 2023) on company profits is booked by its own entry (category C rate), not here

First Schedule by company.sector: 'hotel' 22 % (para 3 (2)); 'petroleumOperations' (upstream petroleum operations) 35 % (para 5); 'mining' (mineral operations) 35 % (para 6); another sector or none given: 25 % (declared); non-traditional exports 8 %, manufacturing by location (75 % / 50 % of the rate), lottery operations (para 7A) and free-zone rates are not applied
unsupported: export, manufacturing-location, free-zone and lottery rates

sectors.statute: Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) First Schedule para 3 (2) (company principally engaged in the hotel industry 22 %)
Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) First Schedule para 5 (petroleum operations 35 %)
Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) First Schedule para 6 (mineral operations 35 %)

wht.name: Withholding tax (non-residents)
wht.statute: Act 896 First Schedule para 8 (b), (c) [text version: Act 870 (2013) and Act 896 (2015) as enacted (gazetted copies), Act 896 para 3 (1) as restated by Act 1094 (2023); later amending Acts not consolidated (flag)]
wht.doc: First Schedule (withholding rates): payments under s. 115 "(i) in the case of dividends, eight percent; … (iii) in the case of any other interest, eight percent; … (ix) natural resource payments and royalties, fifteen percent"; s. 116: "(viii) in the case of management and technical service fees referred to in section 116(9), twenty percent".

rules.statute: Act 896 First Schedule (management and technical fees 20 %)
